narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist Mark; brisk, plain storytelling, including his own Scripture citations.

john-the-baptist.name: John the Baptist
john-the-baptist.note: Desert prophet preaching penance; rough, urgent, humble about the one to come.

god-the-father.name: God the Father
god-the-father.note: The voice from heaven at the baptism; solemn and loving.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: Jesus of Nazareth, about thirty; calm authority, teaching, commanding and healing.

unclean-spirit.name: Unclean spirit
unclean-spirit.note: Demon(s) crying out through the possessed on recognising Jesus; shrieking, terrified.

crowd.name: Crowd
crowd.note: The people gathered around Jesus in Capharnaum; amazed, or relaying a message to him.

disciples.name: Disciples
disciples.note: Jesus' followers speaking together (Simon and his companions; the men in the boat); eager or frightened.

leper.name: Leper
leper.note: A leper kneeling before Jesus; beseeching, trusting.

1.t: The beginning of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

2.t: As it is written in Isaias, the prophet: Behold I send my Angel before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.

3.t: The voice of one crying in the desert: Prepare ye the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.

4.t: John was in the desert baptizing, and preaching the baptism of penance for the remission of sins.

5.t: And there went out to him all the country of Judea, and all they of Jerusalem, and were baptized by him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

6.t: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins: and he eat locusts and wild honey, and he preached, saying:

7.t: There cometh after me one mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.

8.t: I have baptized you with water; but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

9.t: And it came to pass in those days that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee; and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

10.t: And forthwith coming up out of he water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit as a dove descending, and remaining on him.

11.t: And there came a voice from heaven:
Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.

12.t: And immediately the Spirit drove him out into the desert.

13.t: And he was in the desert forty days, and forty nights: and was tempted by Satan, and he was with beasts, and the Angels ministered to him.

14.t: And after that John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God;

15.t: The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel.

16.t: And passing by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, his brother, casting nets into the sea, (for they were fishermen.)

17.t: Come after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

18.t: And immediately leaving their nets, they followed him.

19.t: And going on from thence a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets;

20.t: And forthwith he called them. And having left their father, Zebedee, in the ship, with his hired men, they followed him.

21.t: And they enter into Capharnaum: and forthwith on the sabbath-days, going into the synagogue, he taught them.

22.t: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he was teaching them as one having power, and not as the Scribes.

23.t: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit: and he cried out,

24.t: What have we to do with thee, Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know who thou art, the holy one of God.

25.t: Speak no more, and go out of the man.

26.t: And the unclean spirit tearing him, and crying out with a loud voice, went out of him.

27.t: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying:
What thing is this? what is this new doctrine? for with power, he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

28.t: And the fame of him was spread forthwith through all the country of Galilee.

29.t: And immediately going out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

30.t: And Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever: and forthwith they tell him of her.

31.t: And approaching lifted her up, taking her by the hand: and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

32.t: And when it was evening, after sunset, they brought all to him that were diseased, and that were possessed with devils.

33.t: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

34.t: And he healed many that were suffering of divers diseases: and he cast out many devils, and he suffered them not to speak, because they knew him.

35.t: And rising very early in the morning, going out he went into a desert place: and there he prayed.

36.t: And Simon, and they that were with him, followed after him.

37.t: And when they had found him, they said to him:

37.q: Speakers are "Simon, and they that were with him"; labelled as the group, though Simon may be the spokesman

38.t: Let us go into the neighbouring towns and cities, that I may preach there also: for to this purpose I am come.

39.t: And he was preaching in their synagogues, and in all Galilee, and casting out devils.

40.t: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him; and kneeling down, said to him:
If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

41.t: And Jesus having compassion on him, stretched forth his hand; and touching him, saith to him:
I will. Be thou made clean.

42.t: And when he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

43.t: And he strictly charged him, and forthwith sent him away.

44.t: See thou tell no man: but go, shew thyself to the high priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

45.t: But he being gone out, began to publish and to blaze abroad the word: so that now he could not go openly into the city, but was without in desert places, and they flocked to him from all sides.
